subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat message reuse ship as Copy only, Copy plus Select Copy, or the full Copy/Select Copy/Share/Reply long-press menu?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested action set affects Android interaction design, reply semantics, and scroll/link gesture behavior, so automation should not pick the permanent product scope.

options.title: Copy and Select Copy first
options.body: Add a focused long-press message menu for full-message copy and selective copy, leaving Share and Reply for follow-up after the core reuse path is proven.

options.title: Full action sheet
options.body: Implement Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply together, accepting the larger UI and reply-semantics review surface.

options.title: Copy only
options.body: Ship only a low-surface full-message copy action and keep selective copy, share, and reply out of scope for now.

recommendation.title: Copy and Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Add a focused long-press message menu for full-message copy and selective copy, leaving Share and Reply for follow-up after the core reuse path is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: They appear in recent adjacent Android chat history and are the best available routing candidate for the product-scope choice among the likely owners.
